title: recoverRuns writes the run map under the manager lock
lead: recoverRuns (internal/daemon/runs.go:118-157) writes d.runs.runs in its loop (:143-152) without the manager lock, then takes the lock only for startQueuedLocked (:153-155). It is safe today only because it runs before the server starts (daemon.go:176). Noted in the S05 run report.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Every other write to the run map happens under d.runs.mu. A later change that calls recoverRuns after the server starts would race.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/runs.go`: recoverRuns (:118-157).
- `internal/daemon/runs_test.go`: a test, if one can show the write is locked.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - Not specified. Open: whether a test can fail before the change. The writes run before the server starts, so a race test may need a goroutine that reads the run map under the lock while recoverRuns runs. If none is practical, this slice may be a comment and a lock with no failing test; the owner decides.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Take d.runs.mu around each write to d.runs.runs in the loop, not around Reconcile (it can be slow). Open: whether to do this at all, or only document the "before the server starts" assumption at the function. The owner has not decided.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/daemon/...`
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`
- `go vet ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` (prints nothing)
- `slicer check`
- `adj lint`
